pageId.description: The page id the render was requested for, exactly as given in the input.

markdown.description: The page rendered as enhanced Markdown. An empty string for a page with no content.

truncated.description: Whether the render stopped short of the whole page (Notion renders roughly 20,000 blocks at most). Resubmit the ids in unknownBlockIds to fetch what was left out.

unknownBlockIds.description: Blocks rendered as <unknown>: truncated subtrees, children this grant cannot read, and unsupported block types. Non-empty on many complete pages, so not on its own a sign of a partial render.

lastEditedTime.description: When the page was last edited, read from the page object.

description: A Notion page rendered as Markdown, with its revision and how complete the render was.
